description: Defines classes, structs, and interfaces for managing RRC (Radio Resource Control) Dual-Unit (DU) components in a 5G network, including cell info, UE management, connection events, and metrics collection.

classes.name: rrc_cell_info
classes.description: Holds information about a cell extracted from SIB1 message, including band, PCI, measurement timings, timers, and PLMN identities.

classes.name: rrc_du_cell_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing cell information within the RRC DU.

classes.name: rrc_resume_context_t
classes.description: Contains context information for RRC resume procedures, including resume ID and cause.

classes.name: rrc_ue_creation_message
classes.description: Encapsulates data required to create a new RRC UE, including identifiers, context, and notifiers.

classes.name: rrc_du_ue_repository
classes.description: Interface for managing RRC UEs, including adding, removing, and retrieving UEs.

classes.name: rrc_ue_handler
classes.description: Handles removal and lookup of UEs.

classes.name: rrc_du_connection_event_handler
classes.description: Handles connection-related events and metrics updates.

classes.name: rrc_du_metrics_collector
classes.description: Collects metrics related to the RRC DU.

classes.name: rrc_du
classes.description: Main interface class combining cell management, UE management, connection events, and metrics collection for RRC DU.
